items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: Ed Garland, Montutti was with him in the minor hall and Bud Scott. I even heard Bud Scott.

ctx.x: Well, who was with Ori when you were going out in your college days?

Well, Buster Wilson was on the piano and Ed Garland, Montutti was with him in the minor hall and Bud Scott. I even heard Bud Scott. I don't think I ever heard Mutt Carey but I did hear people like Andrew Blakeney who I thought very highly of and I remember being in a club called the Beverly Cavern in Los Angeles the night that Teddy Buckner first joined the Ori band. Now, Teddy's a fine horn player. No, no question. He really is a good man. He can really get around but he showed up this first time. He had his…
